top_reply.text:
​@CenteIAEducationEnFair enough. I am using it for pretty much everything and it helps me. At university, for example, no matter what I use it for, it always gives me A's (6).
For coding as stuff of course always Claude, unless my daily credits run out, then Gemini is also not bad.
For websites and stuff I use Lovable, cuz it makes amazing sites and I have many customization options, to click on stuff and change it without wasting credits.
Every Ai is great at something, that's why you shouldn't use only one for everything. That's what I am telling my colleagues but they still continuing to use that stupid ChatGPT and fail at everything. Because it's great at only super light and easy questions, for hard things it just fails for some reason. This wasn't the case before, but now I guess it learned too much shit from the people using it and yeah...
